correctness.rationale: The two stable causal convolutions have bounded stationary solutions and identical sign-flipping Markov source. Stationary generator on X^iY^j sigma^k yields exact triangular recurrence with denominator ia+jb+2k gamma; summing alternating binomial moments reconstructs Var(Z) and kappa4(Z). Independently implemented symbolic SymPy recurrence yielded exact zero after subtracting displayed variance and quartic kappa4 rational factorization; denominator factors are positive for a,b,gamma>0, a!=b. Q_eta has positive constant and negative coefficients of every positive power, so it decreases strictly from positive to minus infinity and has one simple positive root. Scaling x=eta*c gives limit (sqrt13-1)/4. Each individual linear marginal fourth cumulant is negative; equal-rate Z=0 is appropriately excluded.

originality.rationale: General negative-sign theorems for nonnegative telegraph response kernels and four-time cumulant sign fingerprints do not cover the sign-changing impulse ae^(-at)-be^(-bt). The 2026/10/18 published network theorem supplies an explicit positive signed-probe example but neither states nor implies by an immediate parameter substitution a unique all-parameter quartic sign transition for the normalized two-filter difference. A 2026/11/02 one-crossing transport result concerns asymmetric time-integrated velocity, not the stationary equal-time common-drive filtered contrast. Standard generator methods may implicitly compute it, so this is best-knowledge originality.
residual_risks: Signed unit-gain pair, a!=b, symmetric stationary two-state telegraph, equal-time fourth cumulant only; no generic signed-filter or higher-cumulant classification.
Two closest external primary papers not read in full; implicit old signed-filter formula remains bibliographic risk.
